findings.problem: Saved nextAction answer can disagree with selection.modelChoice or selection.raw and replay still verifies. The primary motion report reads the latter as the raw model proposal, so accepted inconsistent evidence can misattribute a policy correction.
findings.fixture: Owned copy of expressly allowed fictional three-step UI integration OFF run; result restored after probes.
findings.rootCause: Deferral and sampler replay reconstruct only from persisted selection.raw/modelChoice. Frame validation checks each response answer independently but does not compare the response to selection.
findings.recommendedRepair: Validate and bind the saved nextAction response to selection.modelChoice and selection.raw before accepting deferral/sampler replay; reject mismatches. Recheck both mutations and valid reordered keys.
